statistics: p94.compare_at and p94.compare (p94.stat_instance: stats_family.instance_boot, fresh default_rng(7) per quantity; stats_family.direction; p94.shares), p94.mark_held, p94.verdict_at (p94.verdict_family: instance_boot draws, stats_family.boot_p_one_sided, stats_family.holm, p94.selected_verdict)

pol_vs_best.rule: ahead: the instance-level 95% interval lies below zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is shorter" (draws of that interval) is below alpha; behind: the interval lies above zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is longer" (its own Holm family) is below alpha; not distinguishable otherwise. No seed-level test exists for one run.

policy_start.text: eight runs started from the policy's schedule
policy_start.clock: request clock: a memetic run started from the policy's schedule at run time t - max(o_pol, o_rule), CP-SAT started from it at t - o_pol, the greedy schedule from o_pol on, the runs started from the rule schedule as above

comparisons.smp_vs_bestp: the policy, sampled schedules, minus the best of the eight memetic runs started from the policy's schedule
comparisons.cpp_vs_bestp: CP-SAT (8 workers) started from the policy's schedule minus the best of the eight memetic runs started from the policy's schedule
comparisons.bestp_vs_best: the best of the eight memetic runs started from the policy's schedule minus the best of the eight started from the rule schedule
comparisons.bestp_vs_pol: the best of the eight memetic runs started from the policy's schedule minus the policy's greedy schedule, in percent of the greedy schedule (the form of the decision table)
comparisons.best_vs_pol: the best of the eight memetic runs started from the rule schedule minus the policy's greedy schedule, in percent of the greedy schedule (the form of the decision table)

decision_table.text: p94's decision table with the memetic algorithm as the best of the eight runs from each start, on eight cores
decision_table.rule: the rows of p94's decision table (p94.decision_table) at the production batches, request clock, row Sel: per size, pooled entry and budget the difference of each column from the greedy schedule of the selected run in percent of it, as p89 f2 prints it; memetic_rule and memetic_policy the best of the eight memetic runs from each start (best_vs_pol and bestp_vs_pol of the second set); rules, policy_sample, cpsat_rule and cpsat_policy computed by p94's comparisons (iv), (vii), (vi) and (ii) on the same records and equal to p94's record to the printed digit; bold: the column or columns with the lowest printed value of the row (p94.lowest), over the columns with a number; every column of a row a mean over one set of cells (p94.decision_mismatches)

columns.rules: best of the four dispatching rules
columns.memetic_rule: best of the eight memetic runs started from the rule schedule
columns.cpsat_rule: CP-SAT started from the rule schedule
columns.memetic_policy: best of the eight memetic runs started from the policy's schedule
columns.cpsat_policy: CP-SAT started from the policy's schedule

decision_table.p94_check: every value of these columns equal to the printed value of the record of p94

curves.reference: the greedy makespan of the selected run (p94 row Sel)
